name: speech-cpp
description: Umbrella port over the QVAC speech stack (tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp): one source pin, per-engine features. speech-cpp[whisper] builds upstream whisper.cpp from third_party/whisper.cpp (CMake package `whisper`); speech-cpp[parakeet] builds the Parakeet ASR + Sortformer diarization engine from engines/parakeet under the qvac-parakeet namespace (find_package(qvac-parakeet) + qvac::parakeet); speech-cpp[tts] builds the TTS engine collection from engines/tts (find_package(tts-cpp) -- one library shipping Chatterbox, Supertonic, CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS and LavaSR); speech-cpp[audiogen] builds the ACE-Step music-generation engine from engines/audiogen (find_package(audiogen-cpp)). Upstream whisper.cpp's own bundled parakeet is explicitly NOT built or installed, so speech-cpp[whisper,parakeet] co-installs without the lib/parakeet.* file-ownership clash the standalone ports had. All engines link the single system ggml from the ggml-speech port; the backend features (metal / vulkan / opencl / cuda) fan out to the matching ggml-speech features so a consumer manifest like speech-cpp[whisper,parakeet,vulkan] resolves one shared ggml-speech with unified features. The default feature set is the whisper engine plus the platform's default GPU backend; consumers that want a different engine mix set default-features to false and pick explicitly. Supersedes the standalone whisper-cpp, parakeet-cpp, tts-cpp and audiogen-cpp ports, which remain available transitionally.

whisper.description: Build the whisper engine from third_party/whisper.cpp (upstream whisper.cpp with the QVAC delta; upstream's bundled parakeet is gated off). CMake package: find_package(whisper CONFIG) + whisper::whisper.

parakeet.description: Build the Parakeet engine (NVIDIA FastConformer ASR: CTC / TDT / EOU, plus Sortformer diarization) from engines/parakeet. CMake package: find_package(qvac-parakeet CONFIG) + qvac::parakeet.

tts.description: Build the TTS engine collection from engines/tts: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS and LavaSR speech enhancement, as one library. CMake package: find_package(tts-cpp CONFIG) + tts-cpp::tts-cpp.

audiogen.description: Build the audiogen engine (ACE-Step music generation) from engines/audiogen. CMake package: find_package(audiogen-cpp CONFIG) + audiogen-cpp::audiogen-cpp.

coreml.description: Parakeet only: enable the Apple Core ML (Neural Engine) encoder sidecar (presence-driven at runtime; falls back to the ggml encoder when the .mlmodelc sidecar is absent).

cuda.description: Enable CUDA GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (via ggml-speech[cuda]).

metal.description: Enable Metal GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (macOS / iOS, via ggml-speech[metal]).

opencl.description: Enable OpenCL GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Android / Adreno, via ggml-speech[opencl]).

vulkan.description: Enable Vulkan GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Linux / Windows / Android; Apple platforms use the metal feature instead, via ggml-speech[vulkan]).
